post.title: Scam Alert: How Make-Money-Online Course Upsells Work
post.ig:
That cheap make-money-online course is often just the bait.
People reported losing $750.6M to business and job opportunity scams in 2024 (FTC).
The funnel: cheap intro offer, upsell course, coaching call, big-ticket package.
In its Growth Cave case, the FTC alleged buyers were pitched a $30,000-$50,000 done-for-you upgrade and that promised profits rarely, if ever, showed up. In January 2026, the defendants settled and were banned from selling business opportunities.
Red flag: no proof of what a typical buyer earns.
Sources: FTC Consumer Sentinel Data Book 2024; FTC v. Growth Cave (complaint 2025, settlement Jan 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
